intro.fr: I Hate You, Please Suffer se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: I Hate You, Please Suffer can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: I Hate You, Please Suffer figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: I Hate You, Please Suffer is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
